items.text: Incorporated both answered decisions into plan.md: (d1) reuse existing Popover component from ui/popover.tsx following the StatusChipPopover pattern, and (d2) keep overflow-x-auto on the action row unchanged. Implementation Steps section is now fully populated with concrete file-level instructions.

Readiness improved: approach_solid raised to 3 (detailed step-by-step implementation with specific code changes mapped to StatusChipPopover reference), scope_defined raised to 3 (acceptance_allow already set on spec.json, plan changes align with those two files), risk_awareness raised to 3 (all risks low with existing Popover component handling the hard parts).

Remaining gap: testable stays at 2 because the testing strategy is manual/visual verification only — no automated tests are defined. This is acceptable for a focused CSS/portal rendering fix where the primary validation is visual, but could be improved with a component test asserting the portal renders at document.body.

plan_updates: Filled in Implementation Steps with concrete two-step plan: (1) refactor SnoozePopover to use Popover component following StatusChipPopover pattern, (2) verify all usage sites in backlog-card.tsx. Removed TBD placeholder. Tightened Approach section to reflect resolved decisions. Added Escape key to testing strategy. Converted Risks to table format.
